claims: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged long-term investment accounts for U.S. citizen children under 18.
Trump Accounts were launched via the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill".
Trump Accounts allow $5,000 in annual contributions.
Trump Accounts include a $1,000 government seed deposit for children born 2025–2028.
Trump Accounts are managed by adults until age 18.
All U.S. citizen children under 18 with a Social Security number are eligible for Trump Accounts.
A $1,000 federal pilot contribution is available for children born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028.
Parents/guardians can sign up for Trump Accounts on TrumpAccounts.gov.
Parents/guardians can sign up for Trump Accounts by filing IRS Form 4547 with their 2025 tax return.
Parents, relatives, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 per child per year to Trump Accounts.
Contributions to Trump Accounts are indexed for inflation in 2028.
Earnings in Trump Accounts grow tax-deferred until withdrawal.
Earnings in Trump Accounts grow tax-deferred similar to an IRA.
Trump Accounts are owned by the child.
As of April 2026, about 5 million children have been registered for Trump Accounts.
